extracted.intended_audience: readers and supporters of The Babylon Bee; online satire consumers
extracted.subtask_description: A public announcement from a satirical news site describing a social‑media suspension and urging readers to resist censorship and financially support the publication. Contains rhetorical guidance for the site's audience and approach to controversial satire.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeting public figures satirically
rubrics_metrics.description: We jokingly selected Rachel Levine - a prominent transgender government official - as our pick for 'Man of the Year.' (This was our satirical response to Levine's being named one of the top women of the year by USA Today.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use satire to respond to mainstream or cultural items (mirror or invert recognitions). Selecting a high-profile public figure as the target is presented as a legitimate satirical device; example given is a satirical 'Man of the Year' pick in response to a mainstream list. Anti-pattern: avoiding topical targets altogether or failing to make the satirical angle clear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refuse to delete controversial content
rubrics_metrics.description: We've been told our account will be restored in 12 hours, but the countdown won't begin until we delete the tweet that violates Twitter Rules. ... I can promise you that's not happening.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position deleting the post as compromising principles; treat deletion as submission. The page frames resistance to platform requests as a normative stance: do not erase the content even if restoration depends on it. Scoring note: staying firm is framed as ethically superior to regaining temporary access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assert 'truth' as the defense against accusations of hate
rubrics_metrics.description: Truth is not hate speech. If the cost of telling the truth is the loss of our Twitter account, then so be it. We won't compromise the truth just to keep our account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the rhetorical claim that truthful satire cannot legitimately be labeled 'hateful conduct' as a justification for provocative material. Anti-pattern: conceding that controversial satire is 'hateful' and self-censoring on that basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to never self-censor
rubrics_metrics.description: First, commit to never censoring yourself. Insist that 2 and 2 make 4 even if Twitter tries to compel you to say otherwise. Make them ban tens of millions of us if they want to remove objective truth from their platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage readers and contributors to adopt an absolute stance against self-censorship; frame mass refusal as a strategic and moral response. Example action: public insistence on factual statements despite platform pressure. Anti-pattern: acquiescing to platform demands or advising conditional compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat bans as a badge of credibility or success
rubrics_metrics.description: The greatest accomplishment on Twitter isn't going viral, or building a huge following, or getting verified - it's getting banned for saying something true. We're proud to stand up for the truth...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use being suspended/banned as a metric of having effectively challenged prevailing narratives; present bans as a mark of authenticity. Editorial strategy: embrace controversy as reputational capital rather than a setback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use media appearances and reader support to mitigate platform penalties
rubrics_metrics.description: The media has picked up the story now. ... But a couple of days of media attention doesn't make up for what could potentially be the permanent loss of our Twitter account and the traffic it generates. To put it very bluntly, we need your support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine publicity (media appearances) with direct audience monetization (premium subscriptions) to sustain the outlet when platform distribution is curtailed. Practical guidance: solicit subscriptions as critical financial support; leverage media coverage to amplify the issue. Anti-pattern: relying solely on platform traffic without alternative revenue or publicity strategies.
